title: TikTok Hashtag & Challenge Details Scraper
description: Resolve up to 100 known TikTok hashtag names or stable challenge IDs in one run.

challenge_names.title: Challenge Names
challenge_names.description: Preferred batch input. Hashtag/challenge names; an optional leading # is removed. Combined names and IDs are capped at 100.

challenge_ids.title: Challenge IDs
challenge_ids.description: Preferred batch input for stable numeric IDs. Combined names and IDs are capped at 100.

challenge_name.title: Single Challenge Name
challenge_name.description: Optional backward-compatible single lookup; processed together with batch inputs.

challenge_id.title: Single Challenge ID
challenge_id.description: Optional backward-compatible numeric ID; processed together with batch inputs.
